about_short_description.short_description: B2Broker is a global liquidity provider for Cryptocurrency, Forex, CFD’s and technology solutions for brokerages and exchanges.

product.name: Prime of Prime Liquidity Provision
product.description: Multi-asset, multi-market liquidity for Forex, cryptocurrency, CFDs, metals, indices, commodities, equities, ETFs, NDFs, and perpetual futures through a single margin account.

product.name: B2TRADER
product.description: A multi-asset, multi-market trading platform for Forex, cryptocurrency, CFDs, perpetual futures, indices, commodities, and spot markets.

product.name: Turnkey Brokerage and Exchange Solutions
product.description: Ready-to-deploy infrastructure for launching Forex brokers, cryptocurrency brokers, cryptocurrency exchanges, and liquidity-provider businesses.

product.name: B2CORE
product.description: A Forex and cryptocurrency CRM and client-management platform with trader-room, affiliate, mobile, transaction, and account-management functionality.

product.name: B2CONNECT
product.description: A connectivity and liquidity-aggregation bridge connecting crypto exchanges, liquidity providers, trading platforms, and other crypto-business infrastructure.

product.name: B2COPY
product.description: A copy-trading platform that enables strategy providers and clients to mirror trading activity across supported brokerage environments.
